description: This file defines the SearchModules class for managing search modules in SuiteCRM, including retrieving, caching, and saving module configurations for global search functionality.

classes.name: SearchModules
classes.description: A class providing static methods to manage search modules, including retrieval, caching, and configuration for SuiteCRM's global search feature.

methods.name: getModulesList
methods.description: Returns a list of all search modules with their labels.

methods.name: getEnabledModules
methods.description: Returns a list of enabled search modules.

methods.name: saveGlobalSearchSettings
methods.description: Saves the administrator's selected search modules to a configuration file.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModulesDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the display configuration for search modules, initializing defaults if necessary.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModules
methods.description: Builds and retrieves the cache of modules supporting unified search.

methods.name: writeUnifiedSearchModulesDisplayFile
methods.description: Writes the display configuration of search modules to a PHP file.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of modules supporting unified search based on vardef definitions.

methods.name: getAllModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules used for global search, including enabled and disabled ones.
